lead.headline: EPA sent Osage County, Oklahoma oil-field wells zero violation notices after April 2023, while still inspecting about 225 a year
lead.number: Osage injection-well notices: 88 in 2022, 2 in 2023, 0 since April 2023; formal cases on the same wells held at 14-18 a year.
lead.watch_out: The builder's headline is broken: the 54 Jan-Sep 2024 notices went to small drinking-water systems, not wells, and the Oct 2024 "stop" is those notices moving to another EPA system (SFDW went 12 to 172).
